parameters.content:
## Competitive Intelligence Aggregator

Daily workflow that fetches competitor web pages, extracts pricing, features, and structural changes, then uses OpenAI to summarize differences and send an intelligence briefing.

**Setup:**
1. Add competitor URLs to source sheet (columns: competitor, url, category)
2. Configure Gmail, Google Sheets, and OpenAI credentials
3. Set email recipient in Email Report node
